method.processes: fresh process per backend per repeat
method.chart_statistic: 100 * (median Go operation time / median Rust operation time - 1)
method.distinct_churn: Unique keys selected by a coprime stride over the full insertion domain alternate with a disjoint key set. Every deletion must succeed with the expected value and every insertion must be fresh; checksums are independently computed by the Python harness.
method.distinct_operation_count: min(entries, queries) keys per round; rounds multiplied by floor(queries/min(entries, queries)). All recorded sizes execute 4194304 pairs.
method.before_after: The 50M CPU and RSS matrices include the pre-optimization Go source, using the same corrected comparison harness. Smaller sizes compare the current Go source with Rust.

limitations: Background system CPU activity was observed during local measurements. Small CPU differences are inconclusive.
CPU records include builtin map and sync.Map at 4096, 262144 and 5000000 entries. The 50000000-entry CPU records cover Tree and Map.
The different-key churn workload uses unique disjoint key sets and is not directly comparable to older reports that could repeat source keys.

local: unique churn checks at 1, 4096, 5000 and 262144 entries
